# Mian Law Associates (MLA), Bahawalpur

> Mian Law Associates is a law firm at Chamber No. 39, District Courts, Bahawalpur, Punjab, Pakistan, established in 1997. It is owned and led by Principal Advocate Mian Aqil Nawaz, Advocate High Court. The Founder Member is Mian Aumer Nawaz, Advocate High Court. The firm represents clients before the District and Sessions Courts, Special Courts and the Lahore High Court, Bahawalpur Bench, serving Bahawalpur and South Punjab.

Contact: +92 333 362 1111 (call or WhatsApp) · https://mlabwp.com.pk · Chamber No. 39, District Courts, Kachahery Chowk, Bahawalpur 63100, Pakistan.

Website content is general legal information about Pakistani law, not legal advice.

## Practice areas (each has its own page)
- [Civil Law](https://mlabwp.com.pk/civil-lawyer-bahawalpur/): civil suits, stay orders, recovery, contracts, rent, execution, appeals
- [Criminal Law and Bail](https://mlabwp.com.pk/criminal-lawyer-bahawalpur/): pre-arrest and post-arrest bail, FIR matters, trial defence, criminal appeals
- [Family Law and Khula](https://mlabwp.com.pk/family-lawyer-bahawalpur/): khula, divorce, custody, maintenance, dower, dowry, court marriage
- [Property and Revenue](https://mlabwp.com.pk/property-lawyer-bahawalpur/): possession, mutation, illegal dispossession, specific performance, partition
- [Inheritance and Succession](https://mlabwp.com.pk/inheritance-lawyer-bahawalpur/): succession certificates, inheritance mutation, women's inheritance rights
- [Service Matters](https://mlabwp.com.pk/service-matters-lawyer-bahawalpur/): dismissal, inquiries, pension, seniority, Service Tribunal appeals
- [Constitutional Petitions](https://mlabwp.com.pk/constitutional-lawyer-bahawalpur/): writ petitions under Article 199 before the Lahore High Court, Bahawalpur Bench
- [FIA and Cybercrime](https://mlabwp.com.pk/cyber-crime-lawyer-bahawalpur/): PECA 2016 cases, FIA cybercrime complaints and defence
- [Anti-Corruption and NAB](https://mlabwp.com.pk/nab-lawyer-bahawalpur/): NAB references, Anti-Corruption Establishment Punjab cases, call-up notices, bail
